captions.detailed: A floor-standing bicycle pump featuring a tall blue barrel mounted on a wide, flat black base. A silver metal plunger rod extends from the top of the barrel, capped by a black T-handle with a rotatable sleeve grip on one side. Near the bottom, a circular grey and black pressure gauge is attached, and a flexible black hose loops down to a dual-head valve connector equipped with an orange clamping lever. The plunger rod translates vertically, the handle sleeve rotates continuously around its crossbar, and the orange clamp lever hinges on the valve head.
captions.instruction: Generate a CAD model of a bicycle floor pump. Include a tall blue cylindrical barrel on a wide flat black base, a low-mounted circular pressure gauge, a flexible black hose leading to a dual-head valve with an orange clamp lever, and a vertical metal plunger rod topped with a T-handle that has a rotating sleeve grip.
captions.factory: Construct the base using a flat box and a cylindrical collar. Create the main pump barrel as a tall cylinder, adding a smaller horizontal cylinder and disk for the pressure gauge. Model the flexible hose using a swept circle along a curved wire, terminating in a dual-head valve body composed of combined cylinders, complete with a small box and cylinder for the orange lever. Build the plunger assembly from a thin vertical cylinder (rod) joined to a horizontal cylinder (handle crossbar), and add a slightly larger cylinder around one half of the crossbar to represent the rotating sleeve grip.
